detailed_description:
Daylight is a multiplayer open world survival game

Gameplay

Although the size of this game is small, it has rich and diverse gameplay

You can gather supplies in your house, hunt in the forest, and build homes in your favorite places

However, there are also many challenges and dangers in this end times

Game features

Although this game has some magical elements, it has extremely hardcore systems such as health, stamina, and hunger and thirst values

You can find the material area anywhere and collect some food, drinks, and medicine there to supplement according to your own state

Enemy/animal

There are many enemies in the game

Zombies: The most common enemy, with a general speed of movement, but often appear in groups

Soldier Mutation: Wielding a rifle, it deals extremely high damage. Survivors should exercise caution!

Mecha zombie: the final boss, with extremely high health, can summon soldier mutants to fight alongside it

Although it is the end of the world, there are also animals often appearing in this desolate land

Common animals can be slowly approached and hunted for food

But if you encounter those beasts, I can only wish you good luck

Map

The in-game scene is mainly rural scenery, with a highway running through it. It is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and is complemented by the game's day-night cycle system. It is also a good experience to see this beautiful landscape

There is an abandoned factory on the map boundary. It is said that there are abundant supplies, but it is the outbreak site of the zombie plague. No one who has been there has returned alive. Please survivors try to explore together!

arms

There are 5 kinds of firearms and a melee weapon (sword) in the game

The quantity is not large, but the types are complete: pistols, rifles, shotguns, sniper rifles, and howitzers

And a variety of tactical accessories, such as silencers, lasers, sights, and so on

Multiplayer game

A single game can support up to 8 people playing online at the same time. Call your friends and have fun in this dangerous world!

Reflections

This game was developed by me for nearly a year, overturned and redone twice, and went through countless difficulties

There are many bugs and rough areas in the game, please forgive me, but I will continue to update the gameplay and fix bugs. I also greatly appreciate your support and suggestions. I will try my best to incorporate them!

I started learning Unreal Engine last year. From the beginning of my ignorance, I have now learned a little bit. The difficulties and obstacles on the way have not trapped me, and I have finally come up with this work for everyone to experience

I am a 13-year-old junior high school student, but I have loved video games since I was a child. I grew up playing console games and longed to develop a game of my own. Now, my dream has been initially realized (I haven't been able to realize most of my ideas, but this is my first work that I have learned from experience and lessons. The quality is relatively mediocre, but it is also my labor. You can criticize it, but please respect my work.)

Finally, I wish you all a happy time!

short_description: Energy crisis, social chaos, zombie plague outbreak, you, as one of the few survivors, will survive in this vast land and find the antidote to the plague. You ready? Grab your friends, grab your gear, and start your post-apocalyptic survival journey!

English*, Simplified Chinese*
